article.story: MOSCOW, Idaho -- — Hamad Mousa had 19 points to lead Cal Poly to an 83-74 victory over Idaho on Friday night. Mousa also contributed six rebounds for the Mustangs (2-2). Jess Esso Essis totaled 16 points and eight rebounds. Austin Goode had 13 points. Miles Klapper finished with 24 points, six assists and two steals for the Vandals (2-2). Kristian Gonzalez added 19 points and nine rebounds, and Kase Wynott also scored 19. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
